meta.source: https://www.avec.ai/ (measured via CLONE_SPEC.md, 2026-10-21; /terms and /privacy-policy are linked but were not captured)
meta.status: draft: home measured live, legal routes unverified

categories.SHELL: Fixed UI layered over the scroll container on every stop: header, progress dots, scroll hint, modal.
categories.HERO: First scroll stop: headline, subcopy, CTA, and the autoplaying hero video.
categories.DECK: Sticky 4-viewport section that explains email triage: word-reveal copy, swipeable card stack, and the Stack Challenge game.
categories.EXPAND: Sticky 7-viewport section driven by one integer scroll state (0-6): voice compose, low-importance triage, search and notifications demos.
categories.FOOTER: Closing stop: download headline, CTAs and legal/social bar.

shell.header.description: Fixed white header bar with the Avec logo, a TestFlight 'Get early access' link and a 'Get notified' button that opens the modal.
shell.header.scope: Fixed over every scroll stop on the home route.

shell.progress-dots.description: Right-edge column of 13 invert-blend dots, one per scroll stop, with hover frame-preview tooltips and click-to-jump.
shell.progress-dots.scope: Home route, md and wider only.

shell.scroll-hint.description: Floating 'Scroll or use arrow keys to page through this site' pill that appears after 5 seconds without scrolling on selected stops.
shell.scroll-hint.scope: Home route, md and wider only.

shell.notify-modal.description: Portal modal with email capture for 'Get notified' on other platforms (iOS-only app today); blurred scale-in animation.
shell.notify-modal.scope: Opened from the 'Get notified' buttons in the header and footer on the home route.

hero.copy.description: H1 'Handle your inbox in one minute a day', subcopy, early-access CTA and the 400+ reviews rating row.

hero.video.description: Square rounded media frame: triage video that crossfades to a looping waves video, with a 'Scroll to learn more' pill and a pause/play/replay control.

deck.word-reveal-copy.description: Left-column paragraph whose characters and words reveal from 15% to full black as the user scrolls.

deck.email-stack.description: Stack of 320x474 email cards on a panel whose background shifts surface, green, sky; the top cards swipe 'Done' then 'Later' as scroll progresses.

deck.triage-game.description: 'Avec Stack Challenge': intro card, 3-2-1 countdown, 20-second sorting game, and a score and leaderboard finish screen.

expand.compose-demo.description: Clip-path stage that turns surface, red, brand, amber while a scrubbed phone video plays voice compose, with word-reveal captions per state.

expand.be-here-now.description: Blue 'Be here now' button positioned over the phone's Done button that expands to full bleed with a waves video.

expand.search-demo.description: 'Find anything in seconds' headline, a typing search pill and glass answer and sources cards.

expand.notifications-demo.description: 'Stay informed' headline, an airline notification banner and an expanded email card.

proof.reviews-carousel.description: Auto-advancing, draggable, edge-masked carousel of six App Store reviews with star rows.

footer.launch.description: Logo plus 'Avec is available for free on the App Store.' headline and the Get early access / Get notified button pair.

footer.bar.description: Copyright line with X, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, email, Terms and Privacy links.
footer.bar.scope: Home route, stop 'footer'. Presumed on the legal routes; not verified.
